mine noun

a pit for coal, metal or salt

also mines, coal mine, gold mine, silver mine, iron mine, salt mine, mine shaft, operate a mine, mine (verb), miner, mining

classical

Varr. RR 1.2.22: argentī (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 168

fodīna, fodīnae f.

noun, first declension

Other words

  • metallum, metallī n. — a mine; metal

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Traupman 168

  • aurifodīna, aurifodīnae f. — gold mine

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Plin. NH 33.78 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 168

  • argentīfodīna, argentīfodīnae f. — silver mine

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Varr. LL 8.62 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 168

  • ferrifodīna, ferrifodīnae f. — iron mine

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Varr. LL 8.62 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 168

    Lewis & Short: “not in use”, cited by Varro as a possible word.

  • fodīna carbōnāria — coal mine

    also used · modern · Traupman 168

  • fodīna salināria — salt mine

    also used · modern · Traupman 168

  • metallārius, metallāriī m. — miner

    noun, second declension · also used · post-classical · Cod. Just. 11.6.7 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 168

  • effodiō, effodere, effōdī, effossum — dig out, mine

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 168

Examples

  • metallum exercēre
